author.name: Display name.
author.headquarteredCountry: ISO country code of the author's headquarters, such as `US`.
model.name: Display name.
model.groupIds: Groups that contain the model, including parent groups.
model.reasoningMaxTokens.minimum: Minimum configurable reasoning budget, when defined.
model.reasoningMaxTokens.maximum: Maximum configurable reasoning budget, when defined.
deployment.id: Canonical deployment ID. An explicit sort on this field must be final and ascending.
deployment.approvalRequired: The provider serves this deployment only to accounts it has approved.
deployment.maxInputTokens: Resolved input-token ceiling within the context window.
deployment.nativeFileInputs.extensions: Native file extensions supported by the selected route and deployment.
deployment.nativeFileInputs.mediaTypes: Native file media types supported by the selected route and deployment.
deployment.reasoningMaxTokens.minimum: Minimum configurable reasoning budget, when defined.
deployment.reasoningMaxTokens.maximum: Maximum configurable reasoning budget, when defined.
deployment.dataHandling.endToEndEncrypte: Request and response content stays encrypted from the Stogas gateway to the provider's inference workload. Ordinary TLS to a provider endpoint is `false`.
deployment.dataHandling.processingLocati: Where model inference can run. One of the location values below.
deployment.dataHandling.storageLocation: Where the provider can keep request or response content at rest. One of the location values below, or `none`.
deployment.dataHandling.retentionDays: Longest routine retention of request and response content, in days; `0` means none after the response, and null means unknown.
deployment.dataHandling.trainingUse: The provider can use request or response content to train models.
deployment.dataHandling.zeroDataRetentio: A zero data retention commitment from the provider covers this offering. Implies storage `none`, retention `0` and no training use.
deployment.dataHandling.tee: Inference processes request content inside a trusted execution environment.
deployment.dataHandling.teeVerified: Stogas independently verifies the measured workload of the selected target, without relying on the provider to define acceptable measurements. Implies `tee`.
deployment.upstream.gpuCount: Disclosed GPU count; an unspecified zero is treated as missing.
deployment.upstream.inferenceGeo: Anthropic inference geography that the gateway requests: `global` or `us`. Missing on models older than Claude 4.6, which take none.
deployment.pricing.input_tokens.per_mill: Input tokens, without cache reads and writes.
deployment.pricing.cached_input_tokens.p: Input tokens read from the provider cache.
deployment.pricing.cache_write_input_tok: Cache writes with no separate duration price.
deployment.pricing.reasoning_tokens.per_: Reasoning tokens. Missing when the deployment bills reasoning at the output price.
provider.name: Display name.
provider.headquarteredCountry: ISO country code of the provider's headquarters, such as `US`. It does not say where inference runs; use `deployment.dataHandling.processingLocation`.
provider.credentialModes: Catalog-supported credential modes. Does not describe this key's assigned credential.
request.model: Model or deployment selector supplied by the caller, before resolving to a catalog ID.
request.time: UTC request start time, held constant while evaluating every candidate and condition.
request.bodyBytes: Exact incoming JSON body size in bytes, including whitespace and request controls, before redaction.
